profile.availability: Open to internships and full-time roles
profile.summary: I build full-stack products and explore cybersecurity, post-quantum cryptography and AI. My path went from a university in Russia to finishing my degree in India, and the discipline I learned rebuilding my body is the same discipline I bring to code.

npcs.name: Thianesh
lines: Back for another session? The Iron Yard keeps score in reps, not words.
topics: How did Nathan's journey go? :: Roughly 100 kg, then about 60, then around 75. // Three checkpoints, one habit: showing up.
What's the lesson here? :: Small, repeated efforts. Goals change; the habit stays.

npcs.name: Guru
lines: Welcome to Winter Campus. This chapter begins at Tomsk State University.
topics: Where did Nathan study here? :: Tomsk State University, in Russia.
How long was this chapter? :: Two semesters. A short chapter, but a complete one.

npcs.name: Shabeer
lines: Cold out here, isn't it? Every district in this town keeps one chapter.
topics: What is this place to Nathan? :: His first university chapter, abroad. It gets its own place on the map.
Is there more to find here? :: Look around campus for the glowing memories.

npcs.name: Bubu
lines: Hi! I'm Bubu, the campus panda. Welcome to TCE Madurai!
topics: What does Nathan study? :: B.Tech in Information Technology at Thiagarajar College of Engineering, 2023 to 2027.
Where should I go next? :: The Garage has his projects. Signal Tower has his skills and awards.

npcs.name: Anu
lines: You found TCE! There's always a project or an event happening somewhere here.
topics: What has Nathan built here? :: Aratro, an event scheduler, cloud security monitoring and more. // The Garage has the full list.
Did he win any hackathons? :: Aratro took first place at Hack Odyssey 2025, and the TCE Event Scheduler was runner-up at HackFest 2025.

npcs.name: Akshai
lines: Welcome to the Garage. Ideas in, projects out.
topics: What's on these benches? :: Each bench is a project: the problem, the build, and what it taught him.
Which one should I open first? :: Try Aratro. It won first place at Hack Odyssey 2025.

npcs.name: Naveen
lines: Mind the cables. Something's always compiling in here.
topics: What kind of things does Nathan build? :: Full-stack apps, cloud security monitoring, blockchain workflows and a post-quantum messaging prototype.
What's the pegboard for? :: His tech stack, grouped by how he uses each tool.

npcs.name: Shabesh
lines: Hey. This whole town is one of his projects too.
topics: Is NATHAN.EXE finished? :: Not yet. It's still being built, one district at a time.
Where's his resume? :: Top right, any time. You don't need to finish the game.
